name: Blush Ruched Babydoll Dress
description: Flirty babydoll mini dress in soft dusty-rose chiffon. Ruched square neckline, voluminous puffed balloon sleeves with ruffled cuffs, a self-tie ribbon waist, and a flared circle-cut mini skirt.
short_description: Dusty-rose chiffon babydoll mini dress with puffed sleeves and ribbon waist tie

name: Classic White Belted Shirt Dress
description: Tailored white cotton poplin shirt dress with a crisp pointed collar and full button-front placket. Long sleeves finish in structured cuffs, and a matching self-belt cinches the waist above a full, flowing circle skirt.
short_description: White cotton poplin shirt dress with belted waist and full circle skirt

name: Champagne Satin Cowl-Neck Slip Dress
description: Sleek bias-cut slip dress in liquid champagne satin. Soft draped cowl neckline, delicate spaghetti straps, and a fitted mini silhouette that skims the body for an effortless evening look.
short_description: Champagne satin slip dress with a draped cowl neckline

name: Buttercream Smocked Maxi Sundress
description: Breezy pale-yellow cotton sundress with a smocked, shirred bodice and square neckline. Slim adjustable straps lead into a full, flowing maxi skirt perfect for warm-weather days.
short_description: Pale yellow cotton sundress with a smocked bodice and full maxi skirt

name: Sage Floral Jacquard Tea Dress
description: Vintage-inspired tea dress in sage green floral jacquard. Round neckline with cap sleeves, a fitted bodice with a defined waist seam, and a full pleated knee-length skirt for a timeless silhouette.
short_description: Sage green floral jacquard tea dress with cap sleeves and a pleated skirt

name: Terracotta Ruffled Tiered Midi Dress
description: Romantic terracotta cotton-gauze dress with a fitted square-neck bodice, flutter ruffle sleeves, and a three-tier ruffled skirt that falls to midi length for effortless movement.
short_description: Terracotta cotton-gauze tiered midi dress with flutter sleeves

name: Burgundy Jersey Wrap Dress
description: Classic burgundy jersey wrap dress with a flattering V-neckline and three-quarter sleeves. A self-tie belt cinches at the waist above a soft A-line skirt that falls to the knee.
short_description: Burgundy jersey wrap dress with a tie waist and A-line skirt
